cohort: A 39-year-old woman presented with a uterine artery pseudoaneurysm (UAP).
finding: Advanced ultrasound imaging (Power Doppler with HD flow and 3D ultrasound) is an accurate method for diagnosing UAP, and laparoscopic surgery is an effective alternative to transarterial embolization for treatment.
mod_finding: Uterine artery pseudoaneurysms may occur after traumatic deliveries and cesarean sections.
